content: Hello, this is Amazon Support. I see you're having trouble accessing your account today, is that right? I'm here to help you get this sorted out right away.
Yes, I got an email saying my account is locked, but I only just made it. I'm not sure what's going on.
Thank you for letting me know. Sometimes our system flags new accounts if it detects unusual activity. Don't worry, I'm here to guide you through this and make sure your shopping experience is safe.
Okay, but I didn't buy anything yet. What should I do?
No problem. First, I'll need to verify your identity for your protection. Could you please confirm the name and phone number associated with your Amazon account?
Um, my name is Jamie Turner, and the phone is 555-1298.
Thanks, Jamie. Give me just a moment to look up your account. While I do that, can you tell me if you recently received any text messages or pop-ups from us?
Yeah, I think there was a pop-up, something about a virus?

That's helpful to know. It looks like your account may have been accessed from a suspicious location, triggering our security system. To resolve this, I'll need to run a diagnostic check with you. Could you open your computer and let me know when you're ready?
Okay, my laptop is on now.
Wonderful, Jamie. Now, for your safety, I'll have you download our secure verification tool. Please go to www.support-checker-amz.com and let me know when the page loads.
Alright, it's asking me to install something.
Yes, that's correct. This tool allows us to verify and secure your account remotely. Please click 'Download' and then run the installer. If you see any pop-ups, just select 'Allow'.
It's installed now, there's a code showing.
Perfect. What is the code? That lets me begin the security scan for your account.
It says 856-443.
Thank you. I'm now connected and starting the scan. You might see your cursor move, that's me working to secure your data. Please don't use your computer while I'm helping.
Okay, I won't touch anything.

You're doing great. The scan found some irregularities linked to your payment verification. To fully restore your account, Amazon requires a refundable security deposit to confirm your identity. This is a standard anti-fraud step for new users.
A deposit? I don't remember seeing that before. How does it work?

Good question. The deposit is temporarily held in your account and will be refunded within 2 hours after verification. For convenience, we process this via Amazon gift cards. May I ask if you have a local store nearby that sells Amazon cards, like Walgreens or CVS?
Yes, there's a CVS down the street.

That's perfect. In a moment, I'll walk you through purchasing the correct amount on Amazon gift cards. This will verify your account and unlock your access. I'll stay on the line to make sure everything goes smoothly.
How much do I need to get?
For your account tier, the refundable amount is $400. Once you have the cards, please scratch the back and read me the numbers. This ensures the funds are tied directly to your Amazon profile.
That seems like a lot. Will I really get it back?
Absolutely, Jamie. This is just a temporary hold, your money is 100% safe and will be returned as soon as the verification is complete. Amazon takes your security very seriously.
Alright, I'll go to CVS now.
Thank you. Take your time, and let me know when you're back so I can help you finish up the process.
I'm back and have the cards.
Great job. Please scratch off the silver strip and read each code to me, starting from the top.
Okay, the first one is X7P9-LK8Y-2DF3.
Thank you. Please read the next one when you're ready.
Here's the second: R4H2-PQ7M-8S1L.
Perfect. That's all I need. The system is processing your verification now. You'll receive an email confirmation shortly.
And I'll get my $400 back soon?
Yes, your refund is guaranteed within 2 hours. If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to call us, we're here for you.
